title: schizochilus bulbinella

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits that include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
